protocol.thresholds: V2 .5; XLM-R .5; Desklib .5; Tropa .9755912190656111; ConPara margin >2.9423828125; MAGE author class0 logit >3.08583984375.
limits: This is a fixed source/label-stratified subset, not the complete official test or a leaderboard submission.
COLING source metadata includes CUDRT/MAGE/HC3/M4-family material. Source familiarity and unknown comparator training exposure remain even after exact/prefix/family exclusions.
Paper families are propagated where paper IDs exist; missing parent IDs do not allow complete semantic/source-family decontamination.
Zero-width stress is derived from the same selected COLING texts and is not an independent benchmark.
Intel section titles and text fields are constructed identically for both labels; metadata ratings and confidence are excluded.
No new weights or thresholds are fitted. Google Drive whole-file SHA records acquisition bytes rather than an independently published checksum.

bootstrap_unit: Joint model resampling of known paper/input families. Missing topic-parent IDs prevent complete cluster identification. Source-wise Wilson rate bounds are descriptive per-input, not generally cluster-adjusted.
source_scope: COLING 2025 official English test sampled subset; Intel ICLR2024 test matched subset; separate local stress condition.
privacy: Aggregate metrics only. No source texts, IDs or individual predictions.
